decisions.reason: The source changes landing-page hero and prize-section wording; the FAQ already describes the $500 giveaway every 100 sales and is not directed to change.
The existing same-message MODIFY captures placement, sizing, and overlap constraints but omits the client's explicit requirement that the supplied cover image be cropped slightly.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
hmmmmm, I actually prefer the way you had it before.
The top of the landing page looks a bit messy now with the huge writing and large photo overlapping the 'view dashboard' button.

I liked the 'Project Rebuild' you had at the top before with the subtitles, and the whole layout, etc.

I wanted to change some of the wording (but you don't have to go character for character either, if it looks or feels messy or too repetitive or salesy), and I wanted to add bolding for emphasis to selling points, like '$500 random giveaway every 100 sales' or '$5 unlimited, instant commission' instead of having those selling points in brackets.

And I wanted to have the ebook cover on the landing page somewhere... it can be any size, whatever fits the aesthetics.

And it looks like the cover picture i sent you still needs to be cropped slightly.. can you do that or you want me to?

need to change 'win $500 every 100 sales!' to '$500 giveaway every 100 sales'.
and can drop 'constant little cracks at $500' and just leave it at '1 affiliate selected from each 100 sales block. More referrals = more chances to win!'
can also drop 'ongoing roulette spin:'

(my toddlers are driving me crazy right now, but ill be back in a little bit)

value_updates.crop_rule: Crop the supplied cover image slightly so it fits the landing-page presentation.

decisions.reason: The source changes promotional wording and hero layout but does not alter the live next-draw progress counter or its accuracy.
The source does not change wallet provisioning, purchase confirmation, reward access, or cash-out guidance for fiat buyers.
The source revises presentation of the existing one-ticket-per-referral and more-referrals-more-chances rules without changing ticket issuance, weighting, or expiration semantics.
The requested restoration and wording changes concern the landing-page hero and prize section, not the separately defined About page.
The source does not direct any change to the Mission page or its content.
Changing the displayed phrase from 'Win $500 every 100 sales' to '$500 giveaway every 100 sales' does not change the existing one-winner, $500, every-100-sales prize mechanism.
The source does not change automatic prize transfer, payout destination, or any collection interaction.
Restoring 'Project Rebuild' as the hero title uses the already established product name and does not modify project branding.
The landing-page presentation changes do not affect which book, referral-code, badge, or ticket state transfers with an NFT resale.
The source does not change the trigger, recipient selection, or reward components for a mint without a referral code.
